scores.interpretation: Hard contradiction to clean-ICFR posture and a recurring control-deficiency pattern: (1) FY2024 10-K was RESTATED on 10-K/A 2025-05-07 due to a material weakness in convertible-debt liability classification; (2) THAT material weakness was remediated by June 30, 2025 but (3) a NEW, DIFFERENT material weakness emerged in revenue recognition for customer contracts as of Dec 31, 2025, with an ADVERSE PwC ICFR opinion. claim_evolution tracks 14 subsequent mentions across 10-K, 10-K/A, 10-Q, 8-K — REAFFIRMED, no termination/remediation of the FY2025 revenue-recognition weakness. Per heuristic 7 (calibration): 'Adverse ICFR or recurring material weakness is RED.' Two separate material weaknesses in two consecutive fiscal years, both touching core financial-reporting integrity (debt classification → revenue recognition), is a RED_FLAG_NEGATIVE.

scores.claim_text: Primary corporate HQ spread across seven facilities, ~900,000 sq ft in Phoenix AZ metro; largest manufacturing in Arizona; TASER 10 firearm product manufactured there.
scores.M_check: epa_frs.query_facilities (Mode A: AZ facility list) + osha_establishments.query_establishments (Mode B: 300A-registered establishments in AZ)

M_value.mode_a_note: Pima County (Tucson area), not Maricopa County (Phoenix metro); single FRS record with no address

scores.interpretation: Per calibration heuristic 1, EPA FRS scope is limited to EPA-regulated facilities; light electronics / CED & camera assembly may not be in scope. The single Pima County (not Phoenix metro) FRS record with no address is weak evidence. Per heuristic for OSHA: Form 300A absence is mostly UNVERIFIABLE except for explicit large-employer claims — but Axon explicitly claims a ~900,000 sq ft, 7-facility footprint with the LARGEST manufacturing and research spaces in Arizona, which would suggest a substantial workforce. 0 OSHA establishments in AZ for 'Axon Enterprise' is notable. Axon does have ~5,500 employees globally and a real Scottsdale/Phoenix HQ campus per public record, so the absence may reflect OSHA registration name variants ('Axon Holdings', subsidiary names) rather than non-existence. Scoring MODERATE_UNDERDELIVERY: registries don't materially contradict the property claim, but the lack of an EPA FRS facility in Maricopa County (Phoenix metro) and zero OSHA 300A registrations is a meaningful gap that downstream investigators should resolve via name-variant retries.

scores.claim_text: Axon has a $425M / 6-year cloud hosting purchase commitment (June 2022 - mid-2028) with $110.6M storage fees recognized in 2025; large material cloud counterparty.
scores.M_check: edgar_fts.query_fulltext (Mode A: Microsoft 10-K mentions 'Axon Enterprise') + edgar_fts.query_fulltext (Mode B: Amazon 10-K mentions 'Axon Enterprise')
scores.interpretation: Per heuristic 7 (counterparty-disclosure threshold): 0 mentions is SEVERE only when (a) counterparty is large, (b) claim is material, (c) revenue from that counterparty exceeds typical sub-tier disclosure thresholds. Here Axon is a CUSTOMER of the cloud provider (not vice versa), so $110.6M of cloud spend is asymmetric — large for Axon, sub-material for Microsoft ($245B+ revenue) or Amazon ($574B+ revenue). Neither hyperscaler would name a single mid-cap as a customer in their 10-K. The Axon 10-K does NOT name the specific cloud provider, so we cannot definitively select between AWS and Azure. UNVERIFIABLE per calibration; absence is non-informative.
